Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with mechanism of action classified as a positive modulator. Join molecule_dictionary with drug_mechanism on molregno, and join target_dictionary on drug_mechanism.tid. Filter drug_mechanism.action_type to 'POSITIVE MODULATOR'. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles (via INNER JOIN compound_structures), max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, and target_name. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
